works.title: Comic Book Speech Bubble Tool
works.description: A custom Python/Tkinter desktop application for adding comic book-style speech bubbles with text to background images. Addresses the workflow gap between overly-simple web toys and complex desktop editors like Photoshop. Designed to import AI-generated or user-provided images and overlay stylized speech bubbles with configurable pointers and text rendering.
works.quote: I want an image editor where I can take a background image—perhaps one I've had AI generate for me on Discord or elsewhere—and add comic book speech bubbles with text.
